intro: Welcome to the Afyonkarahisar Archaeology Museum, in Afyonkarahisar province, founded in 1933. It is the central museum for Phrygia, and its weight lies in the Roman sarcophagi and sculpture cut at the marble quarries of Docimium.
history: Founded in 1933, the museum is the central collection for Phrygia. Nearby lie the quarries of Docimium, which supplied the Roman world's most sought-after white and purple-veined marble. Most of the sarcophagi and sculpture here carry their workmanship.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the sarcophagi from Docimium, the Phrygian works, the Roman sculpture and the stone garden.
facts: Did you know? Docimian marble travelled as far as Rome: some of the columns of the Pantheon came out of these very quarries. The nearby quarries of Docimium produced the Roman world's most sought-after purple-veined white marble.
outro: This brings our tour of the Afyonkarahisar Archaeology Museum to an end. Please leave the objects untouched and take your photographs without flash. Thank you for listening, and enjoy your visit.
